skill.name: tiktok-hashtag-momentum-and-top-creator-tracker
skill.description: Reads TikTok Creative Center's trending-hashtag list for any country and returns rank, post and view counts, a day-by-day momentum curve, and top creators behind each trend. Output fields: rankIndex, hashtagName, publishCnt, vv and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "TikTok trending hashtags", "TikTok Creative Center hashtags", "TikTok trend tracker", or a CSV/JSON export of public TikTok data.
skill.summary: Collect public TikTok hashtag rankings, creator leaderboards, and trending videos through a configurable Apify Actor.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

content.user_title: Track TikTok Hashtags and Top Creators
content.value_statement: Comparing TikTok trends across markets requires consistent rankings and creator context. This skill configures Apify collection of public hashtag and video charts for structured analysis.
actual_capabilities: Submit hashtag collection requests for supported countries and 7, 30, or 90-day windows through the documented Apify Actor.
Configure overall hashtag rankings, selected industry charts, or all 19 available industries.
Request creator leaderboards with a minimum hashtag appearance threshold.
Configure trending-video requests by supported market, time window, ranking metric, organic status, and content tags.
Request up to four additional weekly video windows and optional top comments through Actor input options.
Run synchronous requests with the Node runner, or follow documented asynchronous API steps to retrieve dataset results.
limitations: Requires network access, an Apify account, and APIFY_TOKEN; Actor usage is billed separately.
The remote Actor implementation is not bundled or independently verified; returned fields depend on that service.
Only schema-listed markets and windows are supported; video collection lists five markets, and the synchronous endpoint waits up to 300 seconds.
The Node runner prints JSON only; CSV conversion, recurring scheduling, private data access, and predictive forecasting are not implemented locally.

use_cases.title: Plan market-specific content
use_cases.description: Compare public hashtag ranks and post counts across supported markets before choosing campaign topics.

use_cases.title: Identify recurring trend creators
use_cases.description: Request creator leaders and filter for repeated hashtag appearances to support manual partnership research.

use_cases.title: Study public video rankings
use_cases.description: Collect supported video charts across weekly windows and compare views or engagement metrics in downstream analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Start with one hashtag market
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect US trending hashtags for the last seven days with maxItems set to 25. Summarize returned ranks, post counts, and views without inventing missing values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a small first dataset.

prompt_templates.title: Compare markets and windows
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect hashtag charts for US and GB using seven-day and 30-day windows. Limit results to 100 rows and group comparisons by observed country and period.

prompt_templates.title: Research industry creator leaders
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect US Beauty and Personal Care hashtag charts for 30 days. Disable all-industry scanning and overall rankings. Enable creator leaders with at least two hashtag appearances.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: narrow creator research to one industry.

prompt_templates.title: Compare historical video charts
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous trending-video run for US and JP. Use seven-day windows, engagement-rate ranking, organic videos, and weeksBack set to two. Retrieve results after completion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare supported video charts across weekly windows.

best_practices: Start with one market and maxItems set to 25; review returned fields and current Apify pricing before expanding.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only intended public-data collection parameters.
Compare matching countries and windows, preserve observation timestamps, and verify source terms before repeated collection.
anti_patterns: Submitting cookies, session tokens, private account data, or unrelated local files as Actor input.
Treating public chart rankings or creator appearances as guaranteed future performance or endorsement.
Expanding every market, industry, and weekly window before checking output quality, costs, and run completion.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: Set APIFY_TOKEN for an Apify account. The Node runner requires Node.js 18 or later.

faq.question: Does this run without external services?
faq.answer: No. The local runner sends collection parameters to an Apify Actor, which performs the remote work.

faq.question: Which markets and periods are supported?
faq.answer: The schema lists 27 hashtag markets with 7, 30, and 90-day windows. Video mode lists five markets with seven-day and 30-day windows.

faq.question: Can I request creator leaderboards?
faq.answer: Yes. Enable includeCreatorLeaders and set minHashtagAppearances to filter creators credited across collected hashtag rows.

faq.question: Can I export CSV files?
faq.answer: The included runner prints JSON. CSV conversion requires an additional export or transformation step.

faq.question: Are usage and long runs handled automatically?
faq.answer: Apify bills usage separately. The documentation provides asynchronous API steps for large runs; the Node runner only uses the synchronous endpoint.
